subject: Request: Can we reference SOC 2 / ISO attestations in FintechCo case study?
messages:
From: Morgan Blake <morgan.blake@fintechco.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: FintechCo Legal <legal@fintechco.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Can we reference SOC 2 / ISO attestations in FintechCo case study?

Hi Vanessa,

Hope you're well — thanks again for the conversations last week. We're wrapping the first draft of our joint case study and Legal asked whether we can call out Redwood's SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 attestations in the public-facing PDF. Specifically they'd like to include: 
- A short blurb: "Redwood Inference maintains SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 attestations."
- A link to Redwood's public attestation page
- A small appendix with the attestation names and year (no raw evidence)

I've attached our draft for context (FintechCo_case_study_draft_v1.docx). Can you confirm what wording is acceptable and whether you prefer we link to a public statement or include an image of the certificate?

Thanks —
Morgan Blake
Head of Partnerships, FintechCo
[m] 415-555-0189

[attachment: FintechCo_case_study_draft_v1.docx (DOCX, 240KB)]

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Morgan Blake <morgan.blake@fintechco.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Can we reference SOC 2 / ISO attestations in FintechCo case study?

Morgan — great to see the draft, thanks. Short answer: yes, we can allow mention of our public attestations and a link to our attestation page. A couple of constraints from Legal/Security I want to confirm: 

1) Don't include full PDFs of audit reports or any customer-specific evidence.
2) We prefer linking to our hosted attestation page rather than embedding certificate images.
3) If you want to list the attestation names + year in an appendix, please use the exact phrasing we provide.

Looping in Marcus (security) and Laura (legal / partnership ops) to confirm the exact approved phrasing and provide the file to attach if a redacted certificate image is necessary. Marcus — can you send the short approved text we should allow and the sanitized attachment if applicable? Laura — any procurement/branding notes we should consider?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
[attachment: none]

From: marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Morgan Blake <morgan.blake@fintechco.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Can we reference SOC 2 / ISO attestations in FintechCo case study?

Vanessa / Laura / Morgan — quick security note and proposed wording. We can allow the language and link requested. Please adhere to the following: 

- Approved short phrasing (one-liner): "Redwood Inference maintains SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 attestations; current attestations are available at https://redwood.ai/security/attestations."
- Appendix format: only the attestation name and scope (e.g., "SOC 2 Type II — Redwood Inference serving runtime — 2024–2025"). No auditor opinions, testwork details, or customer-specific evidence.
- We can provide a redacted image of the ISO certificate (logo + cert title + year) if absolutely needed for visual design; prefer using the hosted page link.

Attached: SOC2_Public_Attestation_Q1_2025.pdf (public attestation stub) and ISO27001_Certificate_redacted.png (if FintechCo insists on a visual). Both are sanitized for public distribution.

Let me know if Legal needs additional language.

-- Marcus Lin
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
[attachment: SOC2_Public_Attestation_Q1_2025.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]
[attachment: ISO27001_Certificate_redacted.png (PNG, 320KB)]

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Morgan Blake <morgan.blake@fintechco.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Can we reference SOC 2 / ISO attestations in FintechCo case study?

Morgan — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per Marcus and Laura, you're cleared to include the public statement and link. Please use the exact one-liner Marcus provided and link to our attestation page. If you want the small redacted ISO image in the layout, attach it as a secondary asset (we've attached it here for your designer).

Final approved copy for the case study (you can paste this into the PDF body):

"Redwood Inference maintains SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 attestations; current attestations are available at https://redwood.ai/security/attestations."

Appendix example (optional):
- SOC 2 Type II — Redwood Inference serving runtime — 2024–2025
- ISO 27001 Certificate — Information Security Management — 2024

Please do not publish raw audit artifacts or excerpts beyond the sanitized files Marcus provided. If Legal at FintechCo needs a DocuSign amendment to the case study permissions, loop us in and we'll sign off. Looking forward to the final PDF.

Best —
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
